Summary

I'm a Software Engineer with over 12 years of professional experience in Java development and strong expertise in technical architecture, leadership, DevOps workflows, and the end-to-end software development lifecycle. I connect design, implementation, automated verification, CI/CD, deployment, and operations to help teams deliver reliable software efficiently. I'm particularly interested in coaching and continuously developing my communication skills, as clear communication is essential to effective software development. This perspective closely aligns with fundamental Agile principles.

I value understanding fundamentals rather than focusing solely on implementation details, and I continuously broaden my knowledge in areas such as Machine Learning and Web Development. I'm also an active supporter of Open Source Software and contribute to the Spaced Repetition Systems and Japanese-learning communities.

I value continuous learning, self-discipline, and ownership. I'm confident and adaptable in fast-paced, evolving environments, and I enjoy finding synergies between different profiles and perspectives. I believe these complementary strengths contribute to effective teamwork and better decision-making.

Publications

KinectBalls: An Interactive Tool for Ball Throwing Games

Springer, Cham
First Author2013
  • We present a tool that was developed in the context of the first author’s masters project. The tool implements an interactive computer game combining the real and the virtual world in a seamless way. The player interacts with the game by throwing balls towards a wall on which a virtual 3D scene is projected. Using the Kinect 3D sensor, we compute and predict the trajectory, speed and position of the ball. Upon impact with the screen, a virtual ball continues its trajectory in the virtual scene, and interacts with the objects around it using a physical and a graphical 3D engine Bullet, and Ogre3D. The prototype game has been successfully tested on a large number of people of varying ages.
  • Link to paper : https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-3-319-03892-6_11
  • Live demo during the Spring of Sciences 2013 : https://youtu.be/v02BcA-EPrI
